requirements.text: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience

* 8+ years of experience in systems software engineering, including design and implementation of operating system interfaces, runtime environments, distributed infrastructure, or low-level platform services
* Set and drive the technical direction for container runtime and isolation stack
* Improve fleet-wide efficiency and reliability of container-based workloads: resource enforcement, noisy-neighbor isolation, and density at millions-of-servers scale
* Extend runtime and isolation primitives to support AI training and inference workloads (accelerator isolation, large-memory and high-bandwidth jobs, gang-scheduled work)
* Partner with kernel, scheduler, capacity, and hardware teams on hardware-software co-design and multi-generational fleet transitions
* Mentor engineers, drive cross team design review, and represent teams container strategy within the Org
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience leading large-scale platform migrations or systems modernization efforts in high-availability production environments
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience with operating system internals such as scheduler design, memory subsystems, or kernel-userspace interfaces
* Experience with distributed systems consensus protocols such as Raft or Paxos, or building highly available and fault-tolerant infrastructure
